items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: So all these great musicians played with me. And then Mingus was one of the greatest musicians you know.

ctx.x: Mingus was in the band. And Billie Holiday, I was excited playing for Billie Holiday and I was scared stiff because she scared me to death. Because she’s a big shot, you know, I’m a little guy you know. And Saunders King was the leader. I wasn’t the leader. She liked me, because she liked that I played soft behind her, I was a good brush man. And she called me — © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
What did she call you now?
